    theorem MagnitudeConjecture.RightModule.FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton.PrimitiveDirectedBoundaryData.directSchur_finrank_eq_one_of_excess_zero {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] [FiniteDimensional k A] [IsNoetherianRing Aᵐᵒᵖ] [IsAlgClosed k] {S : FiniteIndecomposableSkeleton k A} {e : A} {D : PrimitiveIdempotentData e} (B : S.PrimitiveDirectedBoundaryData (S.primitiveMultiplicityInput D)) (hz : DirectedDeletion.intrinsicEulerExcess (FiniteTauMatrix.meshMatrix (S.factorFiniteTauCategoryData (S.primitiveKilledLabels D))) = 0) (X : PosetSpace.Obj k B.ProjectivePoset) (hX : PosetSpace.IsSchur k B.ProjectivePoset X) :

    The sharp direct height, two upper-set squares, and a basis adapted to two filtrations imply that every Schur poset space is one-dimensional.
